# Using the standard method (type 7 in R, default in many statistical packages)
# NASA outlay data from FY 2008-2017 (in millions of dollars)
nasa_outlay = {
    2008: 17834,
    2009: 19168,
    2010: 18906,
    2011: 17617,
    2012: 17190,
    2013: 16978,
    2014: 17093,
    2015: 18272,
    2016: 18828,
    2017: 18698
}

# Convert to billions
values = sorted([v/1000 for v in nasa_outlay.values()])
n = len(values)

print(f"Number of data points: {n}")
print(f"Sorted values: {values}")

# Using the method from R type 7 (default): q[i] = (i-1)/(n-1) for i from 1 to n
# We need to find the position where (i-1)/(n-1) = p
# So i = 1 + p*(n-1)

# For p = 0.10: position = 1 + 0.10 * 9 = 1.9
# For p = 0.90: position = 1 + 0.90 * 9 = 9.1

def percentile_type7(data, p):
    n = len(data)
    pos = 1 + p * (n - 1)
    lower = int(pos) - 1  # 0-indexed
    upper = lower + 1
    if upper >= n:
        return data[-1]
    frac = pos - int(pos)
    return data[lower] + frac * (data[upper] - data[lower])

p10 = percentile_type7(values, 0.10)
p90 = percentile_type7(values, 0.90)

print(f"\n10th percentile: {p10:.4f}")
print(f"90th percentile: {p90:.4f}")

winsorized_range = p90 - p10
